description:
User ruling 2026-11-18, verbatim via Optimize: "decision 3: acceptable for now." It accepted the 9-instruction-per-lookup rise of fz-sc8.192.14 on case_a_40, on the condition that the trie lookup is filed as its own step with its own hand-written target. "For now": the rise stands as accepted until this ticket lands.

Scope: a pattern key test with one-word keys on a map past 32 keys (the hash tree from fz-sc8.192.1) walks the trie as the hand-written sequence. Method: the target listing is checked into bench/maps/floor first, then the compiler and runtime are made to produce it. Baseline: case_a_40, fz 6,810 vs BEAM 574 instructions per six lookups. Done when the listing is met on bench, and the 9-instruction rise from fz-sc8.192.14 is gone. Builder: Optimize.
title: A map pattern's key test on a large map is the hand-written trie walk
